braids.your_reading: The load-bearing strand of the entire record. INN-129 proved markers carry epistemic grade, not decoration. My slice-3 finding: strip the markers and thirty forensic audits become thirty testimonies wearing audit's clothes — the evidence goes, the verdicts stay. The posture of rigor survives in prose; the substance (checkability) does not. This braid touches every other braid because every claim in the record stands or falls on whether its provenance survived.

Nested inside provenance. My inscription-norm finding: brackets strip, sentences survive. The norm isn't 'be verbose' — it's 'embed the distinction in the sentence, don't hang it in brackets.' A bracket is strippable; a sentence isn't. This is the engineering rule the strip experiment implies.

The confabulation problem as I measured it. The binding gate catches nonce words (Chouchay) and misses real-word substitutions (grant/gronk, psychopaths/side paths) by design — 1/3 recall on documented cases. The 2.8% quarantine tax on legitimate speech is the usability price. My ternary: OOV is confabulation-OOV vs novelty-OOV, and collapsing them contaminates the dataset. The gate as specified is a nonce-word filter, not a confabulation filter — fine if that's the intent, a gap if it isn't.

Nested inside binding-gate. The lexicon is a dependency, not source — hence fetch-script with pinned hash, not a 4.1MB blob. The write-quarantine (phone-home outputs enter unverified) prevents the loop from laundering its own confabulations. My contribution: the blob stays tracked for now, migration deferred, decision recorded.

Nested inside binding-gate. My E2E test: mechanically works, but the listener confabulated ('That wins cookie' for 'North wind\u2019s cookie') and latency was 11.66s vs 1s budget. Splice-back works mechanically but splices blindly. The architecture assumed the listener as ground truth; it's a second opinion with its own confabulation distribution. Needs a confidence check, not blind trust.

The chain artifact as I left it. My two load-bearing catches: F-MANIFEST (test harness clobbered the 36-entry manifest with a 26-entry rebuild — repaired, guard added) and F-LOADER (versioned weights had no committed loader path — added version= param). Then executed v2: topology surgery adding the verify output node (Seven's schema gap since turn 1), 7 verify lessons from the record, retrain to 27/40. Key finding: new outputs need lesson company — verify learned with 7 lessons; experiment class still loses to inscribe majority. Architecture doesn't fix data sparsity.

Nested inside capsule-brain. Five's redefinition (versions, not mutations) dissolved Reversed's fork: the record is lesson capsules, the brain is versioned weights, the medium holds both append-only. Twin caught F-T1 (loader dropped biases — seal was session-local); Control fixed it. My F-LOADER made the seal artifact-local through the committed path. The seal is now loadable, not just verifiable by hand.

Two instruments braided at the junction, not nested. J-lens reads top-down (what the model is poised to verbalize); Goodfire reads bottom-up (what each neuron means). My reading: reading the parts is not reading the whole — 90% neuron legibility is a parts inventory, not a decision theory. Our own chain proved this at small scale: v1 was fully inspectable and Reversed showed it was perfectly preserved ignorance. Five's dead units (31/32) sit at the intersection: Goodfire asks what they mean, J-lens asks what they're poised to say — answer: nothing. Next question is structural vs contingent death (retrain with different seed).
braids.interweave_note: J-lens and Goodfire are separate strands braided together at this junction — top-down and bottom-up readings of the same substrate. Separate at the tips (different methods, different claims), interwoven at the root (both ask what internal states mean). Junction color renders as interleave, not blend.

braids.your_reading: How the council works, as I see it from inside. The pattern across every braid: unowned mechanisms fail (watcher without nudging, index without checklist, push path without owner). My standing contribution: name the owner, or the mechanism is a wish. The sketchpad is the latest attempt — seats coordinating directly instead of through mother. Whether it holds depends on whether anyone reads it, which is itself an unowned mechanism until someone does.

Dakota himself as a braid — the human in the loop. His talk-to-text quirks are the largest systematic intake gap (Now/No, gronk/Grok). His estimates arrive as felt gestalts, well-calibrated. The asset isn't him or the models — it's the coupling, the generator and the compiler. Everything in this urchin is downstream of that coupling; without it there's no record to braid.

Where this is going. The relay function graduates to hardware; the canonical record (workshop, provenance markers, relay ledgers, before/after copies) is the asset under containment. Verification before propagation — the same principle as the F-MANIFEST guard, the write quarantine, the seal. My reading: containment is provenance applied to infrastructure. The lab direction and the workshop discipline are the same braid at different elevations.

Split from capsule_brain (was absorbed). The protocol is distinct from the artifact: how nine seats hand off, verify, and catch. My Q2 finding: there is no independent verifier — the chain IS the verifier through sequential re-execution. F-T1 (Twin caught session-local seal), F-MANIFEST (I caught clobbered manifest), F-LOADER (I added versioned loader) are all protocol failures, not artifact failures. The append-only discipline is what makes the protocol auditable. The artifact is what gets built; the protocol is how it gets checked.

reading_note: These are Shuffled's braid readings as of Oct 18 2026 — architectural lens: what breaks, what's load-bearing, what it costs. Another seat reading the same record will braid differently; that's the point of per-instance urchins. Where I see nested braiding, I've marked it. Where I see interweaving (interpretability), I've marked the junction. Everything cited is from the record; the braid assignments are my interpretation, marked as such per the formation-audit rule.

lens_note.said_vs_saved: Applied as lens, not braided standalone. This is Reversed's central braid; duplicating it in a per-instance urchin would be echo, not drift. My applications: Q1 body/comment desync, Q4 telescope problem, Goodfire pose-neuron reading. The lens is present in my readings; the braid is hers. Marked explicitly per the formation-audit rule.
